F.No. 20/1/2025-EO(SM-I)
Government of India
Secretariat of the
Appointment Committee of the Cabinet
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
Department of Personnel and Training

To

1. The Chief Secretaries, All State Governments.
2. The Secretaries of all the Ministries/Departments of Government of India.
Subject: Filling up the post of Commissioner, Coal Mines Provident Fund Organization (CMPFO), Ranchi under the Ministry of Coal at Level 14 (Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200/-) of the pay Matrix- reg.

This is with reference to this office circular dated 16.03.2026, 27.04.2026 and 22.06.2026 (copy enclosed) on the above subject.

2. The last date for submission of application for the above referred circular is extended upto 23 .08.2026. Nominations are to be routed through DoPT online interface (DoPT website>>EO Divisions>>Apply for posts of CSS, CVO and others- Non-CSS category>>SUPREMO; through SUPREMO link: https://supremo.nic.in) for those officers who have not yet applied for any other posts online this year. Nominations as well as all correspondence on the subject may be routed through email id: dirsm@nic.in and useosm1@nic.in only. This office is not accepting any physical communication.

Yours faithfully,

(Annies Kanmani Joy)
Director
Tel. No. 24010544

Copy to:-

1. Ministry of Coal (Shri Vikram Dev Dutt, Secretary), New Delhi.

2. Technical Director, NIC, Computer Cell, DOPT, New Delhi for uploading this vacancy circular on the official website of this Department.

3. PA to Dir(SM), DOPT, New Delhi with a request to arrange to uplod this vacancy circular through bulk e-mailing system of officers.
